name: MonarchCalloutBlock
title: CalloutBlock
summary: A highlighted block inside a document: a tone, an icon and any content. The display form of the document callout block.
whenToUse: To set a note, a tip or a warning apart from the surrounding text in a document, an article or a help page.
whenNotToUse: For a status message with a title and an action, use MonarchBanner. For a banner across a screen, use MonarchCalloutBanner.
api: init(systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, toneLabel: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)
init(_ text: String, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, toneLabel: String? = nil) where Content == Text

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the SF Symbol of the tone.

options.name: tone
options.description: Selects the tint, the border and the icon.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the tone.

options.name: content
options.description: The content, in a leading-aligned vertical stack.

appearance: A container with 12-point corners, the subtle fill and the border of its tone, the icon in the strong colour of the tone and content in the default text colour. The neutral tone sits on the subtle background with the default border and a small dot as its icon.
platformNotes: Only the display form is offered. The web component is also a node of the rich-text editor with a tone picker above the text (the toolbar slot, CalloutBlockExtension and its messages); that editing form belongs to the block editor, which is not part of this entry. The web icon can be removed with null; here an icon is always shown. Android builds the same component.
accessibility: The icon is read as the name of the tone before the content, so the tone does not depend on colour; toneLabel replaces the name.
The neutral tone has no spoken name and its dot is hidden from VoiceOver.
The block is a container: the views of the content stay separate elements, so links and buttons inside it are reachable.
Text in the content takes the body type role unless it sets its own, and scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Empty content draws the icon in an otherwise empty block.
The block fills the width it is given.

examples.title: Tones
examples.template:
VStack(spacing: 8) {
    MonarchCalloutBlock({{callouts.0.text}}, tone: {{callouts.0.tone|tone}})
    MonarchCalloutBlock({{callouts.1.text}}, tone: {{callouts.1.tone|tone}})
    MonarchCalloutBlock({{callouts.2.text}}, tone: {{callouts.2.tone|tone}})
    MonarchCalloutBlock({{callouts.3.text}}, tone: {{callouts.3.tone|tone}})
    MonarchCalloutBlock({{callouts.4.text}}, tone: {{callouts.4.tone|tone}})
}
examples.code:
VStack(spacing: 8) {
    MonarchCalloutBlock("Drafts are visible only to you.", tone: .neutral)
    MonarchCalloutBlock("The import keeps existing labels.", tone: .info)
    MonarchCalloutBlock("The checklist is complete.", tone: .success)
    MonarchCalloutBlock("Archive the old project before you start.", tone: .warning)
    MonarchCalloutBlock("Deleted pages cannot be restored.", tone: .danger)
}
